title: Repentance and the Change of Nature
english: Having repented of him very much. For in this way, the one having cast away the prostituting way in the house of God was received to the Church.

Regarding the fact that there is nothing of an evil nature, as some of the heterodox boast, a change of choice occurs; this is shown from the Gospel, by the Canaanite woman changing from a dog into a woman, becoming a daughter of the one who saved her, having said these things: 'Daughter, your faith has saved you' (Matthew 15:28). For perhaps because of this she happened to be a dog before the faith, because she was an unrestrained woman; ... for [she was] looking toward a greedy and shameful flattery ... a dog; immediately indeed, with a prostituting wage it is forbidden, the law saying: 'Not...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
